notes.zh-CN: 手机端可以查看电脑会话的套餐额度，包括 Grok、Codex、Antigravity 的每周、每月或小时窗口及重置时间，也能看到上下文占用；电脑上排队中的消息现在会显示在手机里，可按条移除或整队取消。打开会话里的图片时，桌面端会把原图缩成手机可加载的预览图。桌面端 Codex 在 CLI 提供时默认优先使用 gpt-6.2-sol，出错提示行可以一键移除。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: The phone now shows each session’s plan allowance — Grok, Codex and Antigravity weekly, monthly or hourly windows with reset times — plus context fill. Messages queued on the computer are listed on the phone and can be removed one at a time or all at once. Opening a picture in a mirrored conversation makes the desktop shrink the original into a preview the phone can load. On desktop, Codex prefers gpt-6.2-sol when the CLI advertises it, and error lines can be dismissed. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
